description: Create Layer 2 Security and Compliance Agent Workflows with supporting scripts. Includes security scanning, container scanning, drift detection, and license auditing.
steps: Create .github/scripts/security-patterns.yml defining custom patterns to scan for: (1) hardcoded secrets (AWS keys, API tokens, JWT secrets, private keys), (2) dangerous functions (eval, exec, innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML), (3) injection patterns (string concatenation in queries, unsanitized user input in MongoDB queries), (4) SSRF patterns (user-controlled URL construction without validation), (5) path traversal patterns (../)

Create .github/workflows/agent-security-scan.yml: triggers on pull_request and schedule (weekly cron: '0 3 * * 0') and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout code, (2) Run gitleaks with custom config to scan for secrets, (3) Grep-based scan using patterns from security-patterns.yml for dangerous code patterns, (4) Scan Python deps for known CVEs using pip-audit, (5) Scan npm deps using npm audit --audit-level=high, (6) If findings, create a GitHub issue with label 'security' listing all findings, (7) Comment on PR with summary. Permissions: contents read + issues write + pull-requests write. Fail the workflow on critical findings

Create .github/workflows/agent-container-scan.yml: triggers on push to main (paths: apps/backend/Dockerfile, apps/backend/requirements.txt) and schedule (weekly cron: '0 4 * * 0') and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout, (2) Build Docker image from apps/backend/Dockerfile, (3) Run Trivy vulnerability scanner (aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0) on the built image, (4) Fail on CRITICAL or HIGH severity, (5) Upload SARIF results, (6) If new vulnerabilities found vs last scan, create issue with 'security' label. Permissions: contents read + security-events write + issues write

Create .github/scripts/check-env-sync.sh: reads .env.shared to extract all variable names, then greps code files (*.py, *.ts, *.toml, *.yml) for os.environ/process.env/env. references. Reports any variables referenced in code but missing from .env.shared, and any variables in .env.shared not used anywhere. Exit 1 if critical variables are missing from documentation

Create .github/workflows/agent-drift-detection.yml: triggers on pull_request and schedule (daily cron: '0 6 * * *') and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout with full history, (2) Run existing .github/scripts/four_cloud_delegation_drift.sh, (3) Run .github/scripts/check-env-sync.sh for environment variable completeness, (4) Validate wrangler.toml has required fields (name, main, compatibility_date, account_id reference), (5) If any check fails, comment on PR with findings. Permissions: contents read + pull-requests write + issues write. Concurrency group: drift-${{ github.ref }}

Create .github/workflows/agent-license-audit.yml: triggers on schedule (weekly cron: '0 5 * * 1') and workflow_dispatch. Steps: (1) Checkout, (2) Setup Python + Node, (3) Install pip-licenses for Python deps, (4) Run pip-licenses and flag GPL/AGPL/SSPL licenses, (5) Run pnpm licenses list and parse for incompatible licenses, (6) If incompatible license found, create issue with 'compliance' label listing the dependency and its license. Permissions: contents read + issues write
acceptance_criteria: All 4 workflow YAML files exist with valid syntax
security-patterns.yml exists with pattern categories for secrets, dangerous functions, injection, SSRF
check-env-sync.sh exists and is executable (has proper shebang)
agent-security-scan.yml scans both Python and npm dependencies
agent-container-scan.yml uses Trivy for Docker image scanning
agent-license-audit.yml checks both pip and npm license compatibility
All workflows include workflow_dispatch, concurrency groups, and permissions blocks
verification: Run: python3 -c "import yaml; [yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-security*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-container*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-drift*.yml') + __import__('glob').glob('.github/workflows/agent-license*.yml')]" to validate YAML
Run: bash -n .github/scripts/check-env-sync.sh to validate shell syntax
Run: grep 'four_cloud_delegation_drift' .github/workflows/agent-drift-detection.yml to confirm drift script integration
findings: All 6 files created successfully. YAML validation passes for all 4 workflows and security-patterns.yml. Shell script passes bash -n syntax check. All workflows have workflow_dispatch, concurrency groups, permissions blocks, and pinned action versions. Used @v6 for checkout/setup-node/setup-python, @v7 for github-script, @0.28.0 for trivy-action, @v3 for codeql-action/upload-sarif.
